notes.title: Nobodies: After Death is coming to Steam on April 20th.
notes.content:
Were you Missing Agent 1080's extravagances? We are happy to share that he'll soon be Lonely no more! 

Nobodies: After Death is coming to Steam on April 20th. Wishlist Now:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1816950/Nobodies_After_Death/

Join him on this new adventure featuring:

 13 new missions
 Localization into 13 languages
 Full English audio.
 30 crazy achievements to pursue.

Are you ready to clean?
